title: ActionableProposal
description: A self-improvement proposal generated by the reflector agent from clustered GraderFeedback evidence.

finding.description: What happened, backed by evidence from the bead chain

category.description: What kind of gap this proposal addresses

proposal.description: Specific, actionable text change or process rule — implementable without follow-up questions

target.description: File path, skill path, schema path, formula name, or config key to modify

evidence_beads.description: Bead IDs that drove this proposal's cluster

target_line_range.description: Optional line range for diffable changes (e.g. 'L42-L67')

rationale.description: 2-3 sentences citing the cluster evidence that motivated this proposal
